verdict.rationale: Qapita is a SaaS cap table and equity management platform, so issuing scoped API credentials for agents is a fair axis for it. The evidence pack documents no API keys, scopes, or permissioning for programmatic access, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The llms.txt file only describes the product and says nothing about credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
